bullets_zh: PhysioNet发布心理算术任务期间EEG数据集v1.0.0。
该版本为认知负荷与心理算术BCI研究提供标准化EEG基准。
它支持无需植入或手术的非侵入式评测流程。
bullets_en: PhysioNet hosts the EEG During Mental Arithmetic Tasks dataset version 1.0.0.
The release provides a standardized EEG benchmark for cognitive-load and mental-arithmetic BCI research.
It supports non-invasive evaluation workflows without implants or surgery.

bullets_zh: 该页面列出清华大学脑机接口研究组可下载的基准数据集。
其中包含64通道数据、频率相位信息及受试者.mat压缩包等文件。
这些资源支持非侵入式EEG/BCI算法评测与复现。
bullets_en: The page lists downloadable benchmark datasets from the Tsinghua University BCI research group.
It includes files such as 64-channel data, frequency-phase information, and subject-specific .mat archives.
These resources support non-invasive EEG/BCI algorithm evaluation and reproducibility.

bullets_zh: MOABB 1.7.2修复了与pyRiemann均值API的兼容性。
它在TRCA和TRCSP中使用gmean，并通过关键字传递TRCSP指标以支持pyRiemann 0.12/0.13。
新增回归测试覆盖有助于保持非侵入式EEG基准流程可靠。
bullets_en: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs.
It uses gmean in TRCA and TRCSP and passes the TRCSP metric by keyword for pyRiemann 0.12/0.13 support.
Added regression coverage helps keep non-invasive EEG benchmark pipelines reliable.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.2修复pyRiemann兼容，提升EEG基准可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.2 fixes pyRiemann compatibility and improves EEG benchmark reproducibility.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means. This patch release is based on v1.7.1 and includes the fix from [#1180](https://github.com/N

bullets_zh: MOABB 1.7.1在NEMAR不可达时保留本地缓存上游数据集数据的可用性。
它在NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常。
默认auto provider回退仍可用于非侵入式BCI基准流程。
bullets_en: MOABB 1.7.1 preserves use of locally cached upstream dataset data when NEMAR is unreachable.
It catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at NEMAR download boundaries.
The default auto provider fallback remains available for non-invasive BCI benchmark workflows.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.1增强NEMAR不可达时本地缓存数据可用性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 keeps locally cached data usable when NEMAR is unreachable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: MOABB 1.7.0在BaseDataset.get_data中先使用完整处理缓存再预取NEMAR。
当NEMAR或网络不可用时，已缓存数据集仍可使用。
dataset_bubble_plot现在具有可复现布局行为，便于基准比较。
bullets_en: MOABB 1.7.0 uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch in BaseDataset.get_data.
Cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable.
dataset_bubble_plot now has reproducible layout behavior for benchmark comparisons.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.0修复离线缓存访问并使气泡图可复现。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

bullets_zh: MOABB 1.6.1是bug修复版，自v1.6.0以来有八项变更。
它解决了BNCI2025_001在读取原始EEG时泄漏标签的关键问题。
该修复提升了非侵入式EEG基准数据集评测的完整性。
bullets_en: MOABB 1.6.1 is a bug-fix release with eight changelog entries since v1.6.0.
It addresses the critical issue that BNCI2025_001 was leaking its labels during raw EEG reading.
The fix improves evaluation integrity for non-invasive EEG benchmark datasets.
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.6.1 fixes BNCI2025_001 label leakage and other benchmark bugs.

本次发布感谢 21 位贡献者，并重点扩展了 EEG BCI 基准测试的数据集支持。
它更新了用于评估非侵入式 EEG BCI 流水线的开源 MOABB 基准注册库。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.6.0 includes 68 commits and 81 changelog entries since v1.5.
The release credits 21 contributors and highlights a large dataset expansion for EEG BCI benchmarking.
It updates the open-source MOABB registry used to evaluate non-invasive EEG BCI pipelines.
items.brief: MOABB v1.6.0 更新 EEG BCI 基准数据集与评测工具。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.6.0 updates the open-source EEG BCI benchmark registry and evaluation tooling.

items.title_zh: MOABB 修复波浪号前缀 URL 下载问题
items.title_en: MOABB Download Fix for Tilde-Prefixed URLs
bullets_zh: 该 MOABB 提交会清理以波浪号开头的 URL 组件。
它迁移已有的 '~bci' 幽灵路径，以避免下载失败。
此修复提高了从远程源获取基准数据集的可靠性。
bullets_en: This MOABB commit sanitizes URL components that begin with a tilde.
It migrates existing '~bci' ghost paths to prevent download failures.
The fix improves reliability when fetching benchmark datasets from remote sources.
items.brief: 修复 MOABB 数据集下载中波浪号 URL 路径问题。
items.brief_en: Fixes MOABB dataset downloads by sanitizing tilde-prefixed URL components and migrating ghost paths.
items.raw_excerpt: fix(download): sanitize '~'-prefixed URL components and migrate existing '~bci' ghosts (#1181)

items.title_zh: 修复 MOABB run 命令行参数解析
items.title_en: MOABB CLI Flag Fix for moabb.run
bullets_zh: 该提交修复了 moabb.run 中的 -e 参数。
此前，该参数会把其值拆分成单个字符。
这改善了 EEG BCI 流水线的命令行基准执行体验。
bullets_en: The commit fixes the -e flag in moabb.run.
Previously, the flag split its argument into individual characters.
This improves command-line benchmark execution for EEG BCI pipelines.
items.brief: 修复 MOABB 命令行 -e 参数被拆成字符的问题。
items.brief_en: Fixes the -e flag in moabb.run so arguments are parsed correctly for CLI benchmark runs.
items.raw_excerpt: Fix the -e flag of moabb.run splitting its value into characters (#1179)

items.title_zh: 修复 MOABB 与 PyRiemann 均值 API 兼容性
bullets_zh: 该提交更新了 TRCA 和 TRCSP 实现，以适配 PyRiemann 均值 API 变化。
它可避免运行黎曼 BCI 分类器时出现兼容性错误。
这使 MOABB 基准流水线能继续兼容当前 EEG 分析库。
bullets_en: The commit updates TRCA and TRCSP implementations for pyRiemann mean API changes.
It prevents compatibility errors when running Riemannian BCI classifiers.
This keeps MOABB benchmark pipelines working with current EEG analysis libraries.
items.brief: 修复 MOABB 中 TRCA/TRCSP 与 PyRiemann API 兼容。
items.brief_en: Updates MOABB TRCA and TRCSP code to match pyRiemann mean API changes for stable BCI benchmarks.
items.raw_excerpt: Fix pyRiemann mean API compatibility in TRCA and TRCSP (#1180)

它澄清了 MOABB 示例中切空间中心化的正确用法。
这有助于用户复现黎曼 BCI 基准工作流。
bullets_en: The documentation commit updates the RPA example to use TLCenter.
It clarifies correct usage of tangent space centering in MOABB examples.
This helps users reproduce Riemannian BCI benchmark workflows.

The change replaced global NumPy random state with an explicit random_state parameter and fixed default.
It lets users generate identical hexagonal subject-layout figures while allowing custom seeds.

bullets_en: MOABB commit #1169 changes data handling to use cached data before prefetching NEMAR.
The update preserves NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal, reducing redundant downloads.
